9.$description: PLACEHOLDER. A brand primitive. It sits at step 9 only because it is a hand-written stand-in — ADR-0007 derives the seed's position from its lightness rather than fixing it, so a real theme may place the brand colour anywhere on the scale. The value is Tailwind's default blue-500. Primitives are GENERATED from a brand seed, never hand-authored: replace when the generator exists and a seed is chosen.
